verdict.score_rationale: The board is readable with effort, matching the 6–6.5 anchor because its spacious, clearly sectioned layout is offset by several long cross-board detours and relatively small text at the full-board viewing scale.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and label chips have generous clear space, though the very large canvas makes labels small at arm's length and a few chips sit close to long edge runs.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Six bordered, titled regions make stage membership immediately clear, and each region generally maintains a coherent left-to-right procedural reading.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Arrowheads, colors, styles, and labels are mostly clear, but the purple “valid verdicts” route and blue “narrate crossings” route form long perimeter-style mega-detours that require substantial eye travel and backtracking.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Air strongly dominates and most sections hold only a few nodes, but the bounded-execution and evidence-grading regions each contain roughly six elements and concentrate more visual traffic than the other sections.
